# Description

<!--
  Summarize the change.  A good description answers:
    +  What changed?
    +  Why did it change?
    +  How was it tested?  (name the commands / smoke tests you ran)
    +  What docs were updated?
    +  Does it close or relate to an issue?
  Keep it focused; prefer small, reviewable PRs.
-->



<!-- If this PR closes an issue, uncomment and fill in the next line: -->
<!-- Closes # -->

# Acceptance Criteria

<!-- Tick each box once it holds.  Delete any line that genuinely does not apply. -->

- [ ] `All checks` (the CI aggregator gate) is green.
- [ ] At least one review and approval.
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests (unit, smoke, or fixture-based, as appropriate).
- [ ] Affected docs are updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, ...).
- [ ] The diff contains no unrelated files or build artifacts (`*.agdai`, `target/`, `.venv/`, generated `data/`).
- [ ] The description explains *what* changed and *why*.
